# telnyx_ai_missions (Data Source)

Lists ai missions, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_ai_mission`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `ai_missions` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ai_missions))

<a id="nestedatt--ai_missions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ai_missions`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `execution_mode` (String)
- `instructions` (String)
- `metadata` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `mission_id` (String)
- `model` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
